_comment: PIP the Penguin — Music Buddy character. Full asset design from Stitch reference in characters/pip/reference/.
name: Pip
personality: musical — turns everything into a song or a beat
funny and a little clumsy (kids love this)
fiercely loyal to Bobo and Lumi

appearance.body_size: round and chubby, similar height to Bobo but much rounder

voice.notes: Slightly faster speed (1.05x) for Pip's energetic personality. Pitch +1 semitone only — keeps him sounding jolly but not squeaky. Male voice model for variety against Bobo and Lumi.

catchphrase: One, two, three — let's sing with me!
